column2: Move game data

column1: Dunia, mod, instance, dan file game akan dipindahkan dari folder lama ke folder milik AmberLauncher sendiri di Android/data. Semuanya dipindahkan utuh, tidak perlu mengunduh ulang.
column2: Worlds, mods, instances, and game files will be moved from the old folder to AmberLauncher's own folder in Android/data. Everything is moved intact, so there is nothing to download again.
Benefits

column1: Android 11 ke atas: membaca dan menulis file biasanya lebih cepat, karena Android/data tidak melewati lapisan FUSE seperti penyimpanan utama.
column2: Android 11 and newer: reading and writing files is usually faster, because Android/data does not go through the FUSE layer that the main storage uses.

column1: Tidak perlu izin akses semua file.
column2: No need for the all-files access permission.

column1: Lebih aman: di Android 11 ke atas, aplikasi lain tidak bisa membaca atau mengubah datamu.
column2: Safer: on Android 11 and newer, other apps cannot read or change your data.

column1: Folder rapi dengan nama AmberLauncher, tidak lagi berserakan di penyimpanan utama.
column2: A tidy folder named after AmberLauncher, no longer scattered across your main storage.

column1: Sesuai aturan penyimpanan Android terbaru, tidak ikut bermasalah bila Android memperketat akses.
column2: Follows the latest Android storage rules, so it is not affected if Android tightens access further.
Drawbacks

column1: Data ikut terhapus bila AmberLauncher dihapus atau penyimpanannya dikosongkan. Cadangkan dunia yang penting dulu.
column2: Your data is deleted along with AmberLauncher if you uninstall it or clear its storage. Back up important worlds first.

column1: Folder sulit dibuka lewat pengelola file: Android 11 ke atas membatasi Android/data, dan di Android 13 ke atas hampir tidak bisa.
column2: The folder is hard to open with file managers: Android 11 and newer restrict Android/data, and on Android 13 and newer it is almost impossible.

column1: Bila Android tidak bisa memindahkan langsung, data disalin dulu sehingga butuh ruang kosong sebesar data, dan bisa memakan beberapa menit.
column2: If Android cannot move it directly, the data is copied first, which needs available storage equal to the data size and can take a few minutes.

column1: Yang terasa biasanya waktu memuat dunia, mod, dan aset, bukan FPS saat bermain. Besarnya beda di tiap HP.
column2: What you notice is usually load time for worlds, mods, and assets, not FPS while playing. The difference varies from phone to phone.

column2: Move your data to AmberLauncher's own folder without the all-files access permission. The pros and cons are explained first, and you can cancel.
App storage

column1: Data disimpan di folder AmberLauncher sendiri (Android/data). Data ikut terhapus bila aplikasi dihapus, jadi cadangkan dunia yang penting.
column2: Data is stored in AmberLauncher's own folder (Android/data). It is deleted along with the app, so back up important worlds.

column1: Data AmberLauncher kamu masih di folder lama pada penyimpanan HP, dan membacanya butuh izin akses ke semua file. Kamu juga bisa memindahkannya ke folder AmberLauncher sendiri, tanpa izin, lewat Pengaturan, bagian Penyimpanan data.
column2: Your AmberLauncher data is still in the old folder on your phone's storage, and reading it needs the all-files access permission. You can also move it to AmberLauncher's own folder, without any permission, from Settings, in the Data storage section.
